  • Status label mapping: status 1→pending … 4→featured resolve correctly.
  • Subscription tier: subscription in PRO_SUBSCRIPTIONS → Pro/Agency label; else Free/Basic.
  • Diff rendering: changedFields provided → diff flattened into a single string field (old → new).
  • Config error: Plunk/template not configured → action returns a clear error.

Error handling:

  • Missing template ID → clear config error before any DB call
  • Photographer not found → gorm.ErrRecordNotFound (maps to 404 in controller)
  • Dashboard user missing → partial payload, no error (graceful degradation)
  • Plunk rejection → wrapped error with status code
